tools.name: Root-bridge stability audit
tools.abstraction: Before strengthening a surrogate/local/finite certificate, freeze the exact passage to the root-critical quantity and try to construct the cheapest family or source-level witness on which the surrogate premise remains valid while the required root-critical coordinate is not preserved.
preconditions: a precise surrogate object and surrogate certificate are defined
the target root quantity or implication and the surrogate-to-root lift/limit/assembly/representation map are explicitly defined
a target-specific DifferenceWitness states why the source calibration and target failure mode are structurally comparable and mathematically different
structural_signature: surrogate certificate is locally, finite-scale, source-restricted, or representation-locally valid
root conclusion requires an additional lift, limit, normalization, compactness, integrality, realization, assembly, completeness, or coordinate-preservation step
the missing preservation property can be stated quantitatively or as an exact logical implication
tools.operation: write the tuple (surrogate object, local certificate, root-critical quantity, bridge map, preservation property), then run the cheapest exact target-specific falsifier that preserves the local premises while attempting to break the required root-critical coordinate; if it breaks, retire the weak bridge and split the DAG at the earliest missing preservation arrow
guaranteed_effects: an exact inference-form or source-level falsifier proves that the stated local premises alone are insufficient for the stated root-critical conclusion
a successful target reuse localizes the next proof obligation to a target-specific preservation/uniformity/faithfulness/completeness condition rather than further optimization of the surrogate
non_guarantees: does not prove that the actual target theory realizes an abstract adversarial family
does not prove the strengthened bridge condition
does not identify a universal common mathematical obstruction across Millennium problems
does not authorize literal transfer of source mathematics across domains
does not create theorem, novelty, independent-review, or root-solution authority
validation_obligations: preserve units, variables, normalization and exact target/root-critical coordinate
state order of limits, source/target categories and all uniformity/completeness domains
separate a counterexample to an inference form from a counterexample inside the target theory
provide a fresh DifferenceWitness for every cross-domain reuse
run a target-specific falsifier before treating the audit as informative
record the earliest missing arrow and weakest surviving bridge statement after falsification
